description:
When size matters; The Chubby D-Lux is the tool for the job. Each frame is designed specifically for the build height and offset of a specific fork (rigid or suspension) for ideal handling characteristics. A combination of Reynolds 853 steel and True Temper OX Platinum can take every bit of snow and mud the seasons throw at it. A plethora of wall thicknesses, diameters, and butt lengths allow every frame to be unique to its owner.

Designed around a rigid or suspension fork

components.description: Size specific tubing to ensure uniform ride in any size
Head tube and down tube gusset for optimal strength and stiffness
All tubes are sealed except the seat tube to minimize corrosion (Read about seat tube and frame maintenance)
